translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi mu lufua lu muana.

content.text: Ndiela kuzitisa, a Yave, mu ntimꞌama wumvimba.
Ndiela yamikisa matsiminanga maku moso.
Ndiela mona khini ayi ndiela sakadala mu ngeyo,
Ndiela yimbidila nzitusu mu diambu di dizina diaku,
ngeyo Nzambi wuzangama.
Bambeni ziama balembo vutukisa ku manima,
balembo bumina zithutu ayi balembo bungana
va ntualꞌaku.
Bila ngeyo wunzengidi nkanu mu busonga, wudedisidi mambu mama ;
ngeyo wuvuendi va kundu kiaku ki kipfumu mu sambisa mu busonga.
Ngeyo wutemina makanda,
wubunga mutu wumbimbi,
wukubula mvimba mazina mawu mu zithangu zioso.
Mbivusu yikambulu tsukulu yibuididi bambeni ;
wutiolumuna mavula mawu
ayi malendi buela tebukulu moyo ko.
Yave wunyalanga mu zithangu zioso ;
wukubika kundu kiandi ki kipfumu mu diambu di sambisa.
Wela sambisa nza mu busonga,
wela yadila batu mu bufuana.
Yave niandi suamunu ki mutu weti yamusu ;
suamunu kingolo mu thangu yi ziphasi.
Babo bazebi dizina diaku,
bela tula diana diawu mu ngeyo.
Bila ngeyo, Yave, wuyekulanga ko
bobo bakutombanga.
Luyimbidila Yave minzitusu mutu wowo wukala ku Sioni ;
yamikisanu mambu mandi kavanga muidi makanda.
Bila mutu wowo wumvutulanga landi mu diambu di menga matengolo
wuntebukanga moyo ;
kazimbakananga ko yamikina ku batu badi mu phasi.
A Yave, tala buevi bambeni ziama
balembo ndiamisa
wumboni kiadi
ayi wundanguna mu mielo mi lufua.
Muingi ndiyamikisa minzitusu miaku
mu mielo mi muana ndumba wu Sioni,
muingi ndimona khini mu phulusu aku.
Makanda mabuidi mu dibulu dinneni diodi bakaba ;
malu mawu mabakini mu dikondi diodi batamba.
Yave wukimonikisidi, mu busonga buandi ;
mutu wumbimbi wukangimini
mu mavanga ma mioko miandi.
Batu bambimbi balembo vutuki ku tsi bafua,
makanda moso momo mazimbakana Nzambi.
Vayi nsukami kalendi tumbu zimbukunu ko
ayi diana di batu badi mu phasi dilendi tumbu lalakana ko.
A Yave, telama !
Bika mutu kabika nunga !
Bika makanda masambusu va meso maku.
A Yave, wubabuisila tsisi !
Bika makanda mazaba ti badi kaka batu.
